actions.action: Add pebbles or stones to the bottom of the outer pot, or set the clear pot inside a heavier decorative cachepot
Restake: push a stake deep into the bark and loosely tie the spike and leaves with soft ties
Gently firm the bark around the roots and make sure the crown sits at or just above the bark line
Check the plant daily and re-tie if needed
Wait a few days before watering, then let the bark dry out between waterings

reason: The answer identifies top-heaviness and an unstable pot as the main problem, and its first fix (put the pot inside a heavier cachepot or add weight) matches what the poster did, with nothing harmful.
